05 / STAGING AND AGGREGATE ANALYSIS — NO BOOKING FK ASSERTED
Draft IDs become booking IDs on promotion; staging records are not booking children.
Invitation lifecycle is booking-linked through RPCs; the backing DDL is absent, so exact key/cardinality is unverified.
Analysis jobs and reports share evidence_fingerprint; this is an aggregate lookup, not a confirmed FK.
Multi-villa membership is stored in villa_ids[]; no junction table is invented.
Historical feedback can exist without a booking. One verified review per stay is application intent; uniqueness is unverified.
Full base DDL is absent. See docs/erd-notes.md for evidence, caveats, and sources.
